interactive_replay.interpretation: rAF cadence measures browser responsiveness, not canvas rendering FPS. Overall canvas redraw rate includes static intervals. Active animation windows use the renderer data-animating marker and count actual paints during its 180ms presentation tween. Display-frame intervals deduplicate paints carrying the same browser rAF frame token; paint calls and paint duration remain separate. Clinical state changes remain exact recorded states. Playback is explicitly 16× and pauses advancement while remote state loads. Patient counts use exactly the 3.6/6px dot radii, excluding staff icons and selection rings. This is the actual rendered marker count, not an assumption of 500; dense dots may overlap. The complete census remains server-paginated with exact aggregate counts.
